t: These Scruffs K002 knee pad inserts provide essential protection for professionals working on their knees. Made from durable polyethylene, they offer reliable cushioning and support. Ideal for plumbers, tilers, and general builders, these inserts fit into compatible work trousers, ensuring comfort during prolonged tasks. The robust construction helps to reduce impact and pressure, making them a practical choice for daily site work. A 1-year manufacturer's guarantee provides added peace of mind.
